content.text: {"sql":"SELECT date_trunc('month', decision_date)::DATE AS month, SUM(n_decisions) AS decisions, SUM(n_approved) AS approvals, SUM(n_approved)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(n_decisions), 0) AS approval_rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE lower(platform) = 'android' AND lower(doc_type) LIKE '%national%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;","rationale":"Monthly approval rates show the late-2025 decline and subsequent recovery for Android national-ID KYC, with counts to assess how much data supports each level."}
